# Jeuxvideo.com — camp production and arrow shortages

- Original title: probleme a sherwood
- Source: [Original publication](https://www.jeuxvideo.com/forums/1-7514-14072614-1-0-1-0-0.htm)
- Author / publisher: lerapace1411, Quedza, T_Sentenza, iPiero, Zapotec, and other forum participants
- Language / date: French; 2006-10-28 through 2013-08-18
- Access: Complete displayed discussion inspected.
- Checked: 2026-09-09

The opening question concerns running out of arrows needed for ambush traps. Quedza distinguishes story missions from ambushes for camp production; T_Sentenza later repeats that distinction and suggests conserving arrows through melee and pickups. Other replies discuss sparing enemies with Little John or using Will against resistant knights.

A 2012 Mac player separately reports an unresponsive cheat shortcut and being limited to ambushes; no confirmed Mac-specific solution follows. This thread supplies evidence that confusion over production and depleted supplies long predates the recent Steam and GOG reports. Advice and reported outcomes were not independently tested.
